# Setting up walks you through it {checkmark.seal}
The first launch now asks for each macOS permission one at a time, says what it
lets RecordLah do — and what it does not — and waits for that one before moving
on. Nothing appears behind your back any more.

# Leaving a meeting takes two seconds {door.left.hand.open}
It took eleven. Worse, as the host it was pressing Zoom's default button, which
ends the meeting for everyone instead of just leaving it. It now clicks Leave
meeting by name.

# The phone remote answers straight away {iphone}
Every reading it asks for was taking the Mac about a second, sometimes twelve.
Now it is a tenth of a second.

---

Everything else in this release:

- **Your Mac has stopped photographing its own screen.** Checking the Screen
  Recording permission took a real screenshot, and with a phone screen open it
  did that every eight seconds. It now checks once, and clears up the 527 old
  screenshots (779MB) that had collected since August.
- **Scan to connect a phone.** The remote's home page can read the code from
  the Mac with the camera instead of you typing eight characters — and scanning
  from inside the app pairs the app, which scanning with the Camera app does
  not.
- **Keep-awake says what it cannot do.** The setting now warns that nothing
  holds sleep off once the lid is closed: leave it open and plugged in.
- Leaving a meeting says what Zoom asked and what was pressed, so a leave that
  goes wrong can be read afterwards instead of guessed at.
- The first-run screen is no longer used up before it can be shown. On a new
  Mac it was being marked as seen about two seconds before the licence answer
  it needs arrived.
- Pull down to refresh in the phone remote saved to a Home Screen, and the
  paddings around the notch are no longer counted twice.
